# @n3wth/ui

> Atomic design system for React applications. Flat, minimal, iOS-inspired components built on Tailwind CSS 4.

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install @n3wth/ui
```

```tsx
import { Button, Card, Hero } from '@n3wth/ui'
import '@n3wth/ui/styles'
```

## Overview

@n3wth/ui is an open-source React component library following atomic design principles. It provides a flat, minimal aesthetic with no shadows or heavy effects — just clean glassmorphism and precise typography.

- **Package**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@n3wth/ui
- **Source**: https://github.com/n3wth/ui
- **Docs**: https://ui.n3wth.com
- **License**: MIT

## Design Principles

1. **Flat Design**: No shadows, no gradients on surfaces — depth via borders and transparency
2. **Glassmorphism**: Subtle backdrop blur and translucent backgrounds
3. **Minimal**: Remove everything that doesn't serve function
4. **iOS-Inspired**: Apple Human Interface Guidelines influence
5. **Motion-Respecting**: Honors prefers-reduced-motion

## Components

### Atoms (Primitives)
- **Button** - Primary actions, variants: default, secondary, ghost, destructive
- **Badge** - Status indicators, labels, tags
- **Input** - Text input with validation states
- **Textarea** - Multi-line text input
- **Label** - Form labels with required indicator
- **Icon** - Iconoir icon wrapper with size variants
- **Avatar** - User avatars with fallback initials
- **Switch** - Toggle switches
- **Progress** - Progress bars
- **Skeleton** - Loading placeholders
- **Separator** - Visual dividers
- **Tooltip** - Hover tooltips
- **AnimatedText** - Text reveal animations
- **Character** - Animated character displays
- **CodeBlock** - Syntax-highlighted code
- **Shape** - Decorative geometric shapes
- **SpeechBubble** - Chat-style bubbles
- **ScrollIndicator** - Scroll position indicator
- **NoiseOverlay** - Subtle texture overlay
- **HamburgerIcon** - Animated menu icon

### Molecules (Compositions)
- **Card** - Content containers with glass effect
- **Tabs** - Tab navigation
- **Accordion** - Collapsible content sections
- **Modal** - Dialog overlays
- **Dropdown** - Select menus
- **CommandBox** - Command palette / copy boxes
- **NavLink** - Navigation links with active states
- **ThemeToggle** - Dark/light mode switch
- **MobileDrawer** - Slide-out mobile menus
- **Toast** - Notification toasts
- **CompositeShape** - Multi-shape compositions
- **ErrorBoundary** - React error boundary

### Organisms (Page Sections)
- **Nav** - Fixed navigation with hide-on-scroll
- **Hero** - Landing page hero sections
- **Section** - Content sections with consistent spacing
- **Footer** - Site footer with ecosystem links

## Hooks

- **useTheme** - Theme state management (dark/light)
- **useMediaQuery** - Responsive breakpoint detection
- **useKeyboardShortcuts** - Keyboard shortcut bindings
- **useScrollReveal** - Scroll-triggered animations
- **useReducedMotion** - Detect reduced motion preference
- **useToast** - Toast notification management
- **useCountUp** - Animated number counting
- **useButtonPulse** - Button pulse animations
- **usePageTransition** - Page transition animations
- **useStaggerList** - Staggered list animations
- **useTextReveal** - Text reveal animations

## Design Tokens

### Typography
- Display: Satoshi (headings, titles)
- Body: Geist Sans (UI text, paragraphs)
- Mono: Geist Mono (code)

### Colors
- Background: `--color-bg` (#08090b dark, #ffffff light)
- Text: `--color-white` (semantic, inverts with theme)
- Accent: `--color-accent` (white in dark, black in light)
- Category: sage (green), coral (red), mint (blue), gold (yellow)

### Glass Effects
- `.glass-card` - Card with translucent background
- `.glass-pill` - Pill-shaped glass button
- `.glass-nav` - Navigation glass effect

## Tailwind CSS 4 Integration

```css
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@n3wth/ui/styles';

/* Scan @n3wth/ui for classes */
@source "../node_modules/@n3wth/ui/dist";
```

## Accessibility

- WCAG 2.1 AA color contrast
- Keyboard navigation support
- Focus indicators
- Screen reader labels
- Reduced motion support
- Touch-friendly targets (44px minimum)

## Browser Support

- Chrome/Edge 88+
- Firefox 78+
- Safari 14+
- iOS Safari 14+
